# AnimalSkin

Kind: tag · Defined in [`src/logic/animals/steer.h`](../../../src/logic/animals/steer.h) · Described in `data/animals.json`

On an Animal that is only the skin drawn on something else (a world's ragdoll), not an animal to meet.

## Notes

Set by AnimalAgentView (view/animal_view.cpp); the riding systems (logic/player/mount.cpp) skip it.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: Mountables. Written by: AnimalAgentView. Created by: AnimalAgentView. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [AnimalAgentView](../systems/AnimalAgentView.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | tick | marks the skin entity: only a ragdoll's drawn skin |
| [Mountables](../systems/Mountables.md) | system | Host | **read** | preinit (storage), tick | excluded: the drawn skin of a ragdoll is not ridden |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[AnimalAgentView](../systems/AnimalAgentView.md)**
  - Loads the animal library index (preinit) and the viewed species (first tick) from disk on the main thread; logs which.
  - With "log", opens the file once (truncated) and appends a CSV line every frame, flushed.
  - ImGui window "Animal".
  - Creates host entities (one skin per world with a built bot, 800 tiles with marks) that are never destroyed (no finish).
- **[Mountables](../systems/Mountables.md)**
  - Connects `on_destroy<Mountable>` in preinit (disconnected in finish).
  - Reads the species' skin geometry (`resources/animals/species/<id>.bin`) once per species, runs `analyseGait` on its walk clip.
  - Creates a collider entity per Mountable within `range` of a Rider (or ridden) and destroys it when none is.
  - Logs once per species: `Mountables : <id>, saddle <h> m up on <joint>, walks <v> m/s, runs <v> m/s` (info), or a warning when the geometry cannot be read.
